improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
improve.coach: It's come up in 38% of your matches, but only 20% lately. You're winning this one.

improve.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Defenders can draw up all the plans they want; you just scored anyway. 56% of matches. Your calling card.
